title: Misty Shore
wikitext:
[[Image:Misty Shore.jpg|thumb|Misty Shore]]
'''Misty Shore''' is a stretch of waterline running from [[Dandred's Fold]] to [[Dalaran]] in the [[contested]] territory of [[Alterac Mountains]]. Aside from its rather large population of [[turtle]]s, the shore also houses a pair of [[Scarlet Crusade]]-affiliated humans, who zealously attack those who pass too close.

It is possible to view [[the Dawning Isles]] from the Misty Shore, with the eerie [[Fenris Keep]] in the distance.
